lessons.title: Logic of Significance Tests
lessons.focus: translating a claim into null and alternative hypotheses and measuring incompatibility with the null
lessons.essential: How do null models, test statistics, p-values, errors, power, and effect sizes support disciplined decisions?
lessons.application: clinical research, product decisions, public policy, quality assurance, and scientific evidence
lessons.s1: Assuming the null model is true, results at least this incompatible with the null would occur about 3% of the time; it is not the probability the null is true.
lessons.p2: Identify a common error in Logic of Significance Tests.
lessons.s2: A common error is to report a calculation without identifying the population, design, assumptions, uncertainty, context, or limits on causal and generalizing claims.
